tasks.task: Write a Python function that takes an S3 bucket name and a prefix, and uses boto3 to return a list of all object keys under that prefix, handling pagination correctly.
Create an IAM policy JSON document that grants read-only access (s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket) to a bucket named 'my-app-logs' and all objects within it, and nothing else.
Write a regular expression that matches a valid AWS EC2 instance ID, which is 'i-' followed by either 8 or 17 lowercase hexadecimal characters, and matches the entire string only.
